create_coach_dataset: create a CoachDataset from a JSON file with resource binning and instruction filtering parameters
compute_cache_dataset: compute and cache all entries in a CoachDataset using a multi-worker DataLoader
filter_instruction_span: filter dataset entries to keep only those with instruction spans meeting a minimum threshold
process_count_features: process unit visibility and type counts into a feature vector for the coach model
get_num_count_channels: get the total number of count channels used by the CoachDataset feature processing
